Description

Momcozy S12 Pro Quick – Reliable Pumping, Gentle Care

Experience a beautifully upgraded pump that fits seamlessly into your daily rhythm.
Momcozy S12 Pro Quick is designed to make every pumping session easier, faster, and more comfortable so you can focus on what truly matters.

With powerful -292 mmHg suction and the exclusive DoubleFit™ hybrid flange, S12 Pro Quick delivers up to 28.2% faster pumping and 6% more milk output than the previous model.
Every detail—from the streamlined 4-part setup to the grip tab design—is made for effortless use, easy cleaning, and a secure, leak-free fit.

Compatibility Note:

Flange inserts
can be used with both
S12 Pro
and
S12 Pro Quick
. Other accessories are designed specifically for each model, please choose the version that matches your pump.

⚠️
Safety Warning

Do NOT use this device if you have a cardiac pacemaker, implanted defibrillator, or any other metallic or electronic implant, as it may cause electromagnetic interference or serious injury.

Key Features & Benefits

· Faster & More Efficient Pumping.
Powerful -292 mmHg suction delivers up to 28.2% faster pumping and 6% more milk output than the previous model. (*Based on Momcozy Lab data)

· DoubleFit™ Hybrid Flange.
Innovative soft silicone meets firm PP for a secure, leak-free seal. BPA-free and skin-friendly for all-day comfort.

· Simple Setup & Quick Cleaning.
Only 4 parts and 3 easy steps. Designed with a smooth, one-piece funnel for easy rinsing and drying.

· Thoughtful Design for Ease & Safety.
Ergonomic grip tabs & dual-use flange cover for easy handling, intuitive digital screen, and 30-min auto shut-off for worry-free sessions.

· Long-Lasting Power & Quiet Use.
1350 mAh battery supports up to 8 sessions (240 min) on one charge. ≤46 dB whisper-quiet for discreet pumping anywhere.

FAQs

What makes S12 Pro Quick different from the S12 Pro?

S12 Pro Quick has been thoughtfully upgraded to save time, improve comfort, and increase efficiency:

● Avg. 11.68ml more output for efficient milk expression.

● Hybrid DoubleFit™ Flange ensures a snug, leak-free fit with soft silicone for comfort and rigid PP for stability.

● Simplified 4-part design makes assembly and cleaning easier.

● Larger 210 ml (7 oz) milk collector for fewer interruptions.

● Whisper-quiet operation ≤46 dB for discreet pumping anywhere.

● Innovative grip tab design & flange cover doubles as a stable stand to prevent spills.

What is the DoubleFit™ Flange and why is it special?

Momcozy's exclusive DoubleFit™ Flange combines:

● Soft silicone: Gentle on your skin and nipple.

● Rigid PP: Provides stability for a secure, leak-free seal.

● BPA-free, food-grade materials: Safe for both mother and baby.

It’s designed to mimic the natural feel of a baby’s touch while ensuring steady suction, comfort, and efficiency during pumping.

How does the rhythmic pumping work?

S12 Pro Quick offers 3 modes × 9 intensity levels, designed to simulate a baby’s natural suckling:

● Stimulation Mode: Short, gentle pulses to kickstart milk letdown.

● Expression Mode: Deep, longer cycles to efficiently express milk.

● Mixed Mode: Alternates between short stimulation pulses and deeper expression for complete milk extraction.

It helps you achieve faster letdown, increased milk output, and full breast emptying comfortably.

Is it easy to assemble and clean?

Absolutely. Every component is designed for effortless use:

● 4-part quick setup with top alignment marks for accurate assembly.

● Streamlined duckbill valve: Larger, simple design installs and removes smoothly without loss.

● One-piece funnel design: Eliminates tricky corners and buildup.

● Easy cleaning: Just rinse, dry, and go.

All made for less time spent on setup and cleaning, more time for you and your baby.

How long does the battery last?

S12 Pro Quick features a 1350 mAh rechargeable battery that gives:

● Up to 8 pumping sessions per charge

● 240 minutes of continuous runtime

Perfect for busy moms or those on the go, with no need to recharge frequently.

Is it quiet enough for discreet pumping?

Yes. The ≤46 dB whisper-quiet operation ensures you can pump discreetly at home, in the office, or anywhere else without disturbing others.

What is special about the grip tab design?

The innovative grip tab design is inspired by real-life pumping scenarios:

● Easy grip: Quickly attach or remove the milk collector, even with wet hands.

● 2-in-1 flange cover: Acts as a dust cover and a stable stand to prevent spills.

Pump confidently and minimize mess or accidental tipping.

Can I personalize the suction and speed?

Yes. The intuitive digital control panel and LCD display allow you to:

● Start, pause, adjust suction level

● Select your preferred pumping mode

● Monitor session time and battery status

Tailor every session to your comfort and maximize efficiency.

Is the pump safe for my baby?

Yes. All components that come in contact with milk are BPA-free, food-grade PP and silicone. Every part is designed to meet strict safety standards for baby’s health.

Can I use S12 Pro accessories with S12 Pro Quick?

Flange inserts
can be used with both models. Other accessories are
designed specifically for each pump model
, so we recommend choosing the version made for your S12 Pro Quick for the best fit.
